title: Google Earth's AI image generation function pulled in less than a day
excerpt: Google pulled its AI image-editing feature from Google Earth within 24 hours of its launch, after users created deepfakes depicting disasters.
content_html:
Google Earth's new AI image generation function didn't survive a day after users deepfaked disasters

By Katherine Li

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Google pulled a new AI image-editing feature from Google Earth less than 24 hours after launch.

The company launched the function on Thursday, allowing Gemini's Nano Banana 2 image model to access Google Earth and transform locations with text prompts.

The function, however, quickly got out of hand. AI researcher Henk van Ess, for example, created extremely realistic deepfakes, including fake refugee camps along the US-Mexico border and a nuclear plant in Iran.

Other users used the tool to create AI images of a nonexistent flood and a 9/11-style attack.

By Friday, Google had reversed course.

"We've seen geospatial professionals using this feature for a range of useful purposes, however we've also seen people sharing screenshots of generated imagery that appear to violate our policies," a Google spokesperson said in a statement posted on X. "So we're rolling back this feature in Google Earth while we work on implementing stronger guardrails."

Google added that the AI-generated images were watermarked and never appeared in the public Google Earth experience.

Google is not the only company that has lately rolled out AI features only to quickly remove them. Meta launched Muse Image on July 7 with a feature that allowed users to generate AI images using images available on all adult-owned public Instagram accounts that had not changed their settings to opt out. Meta removed the feature in less than a week and said it had "missed the mark."

content_html_zh:
谷歌地球新的人工智能图像生成功能在用户深度伪造灾难后一天就无法生存

作者：Katherine Li 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

谷歌在发布后不到 24 小时就从 Google Earth 中撤下了一项新的人工智能图像编辑功能。

该公司于周四推出了该功能，允许 Gemini 的 Nano Banana 2 图像模型访问 Google 地球并通过文本提示转换位置。

然而，该功能很快就失控了。 例如，人工智能研究员亨克·范·埃斯（Henk van Ess）创建了极其逼真的深度伪造品，包括美墨边境的假难民营和伊朗的一座核工厂。

其他用户使用该工具创建了不存在的洪水和 9/11 式攻击的 AI 图像。

到周五，谷歌改变了方向。

谷歌发言人在 X 上发布的一份声明中表示：“我们已经看到地理空间专业人士将这一功能用于一系列有用的目的，但我们也看到人们分享了似乎违反我们政策的生成图像的屏幕截图。” “因此，我们正在回滚 Google 地球中的这一功能，同时努力实施更坚固的护栏。”

谷歌补充说，人工智能生成的图像带有水印，并且从未出现在公开的谷歌地球体验中。

谷歌并不是唯一一家最近推出人工智能功能却又迅速删除它们的公司。 Meta 于 7 月 7 日推出了 Muse Image，其功能允许用户使用所有未更改设置以选择退出的成人拥有的公共 Instagram 帐户上提供的图像来生成 AI 图像。 Meta 在不到一周的时间里删除了该功能，并表示它“没有达到目标”。
